reflections.title: Jesus Fulfills the Law

reflect.text: When Jesus talks about fulfilling the Law and the Prophets, He does not mean He came just to enforce external rituals or outward legal demands. The entire Old Testament points forward to Jesus. He did not arrive to discard the Law, nor did He come merely to maintain religious traditions. Instead, He came to bring all of God's prophetic promises into reality and accomplish everything the Scriptures foretold.

Jesus expressed absolute confidence in every part of Scripture, promising that not the smallest letter or pen stroke would pass away until everything was accomplished. Because Jesus trusted God's Word so deeply, we can depend completely on its reliability and authority. Jesus and the apostles often read and quoted from the Greek translation used in their era. In the same way, you can be sure that your translated Bible today is fully trustworthy. Christ's teaching gives us full confidence that God's Word can be trusted in every generation.

questions: How does knowing that Jesus fulfilled God's prophetic promises help you understand the Old Testament?
How does Jesus' complete confidence in Scripture encourage you to trust the Bible you read each day?
reflections.prayer: Lord Jesus, thank You for fulfilling the promises of Scripture and bringing God's word into reality. Help us to share Your deep confidence in the Bible and rely on its truth every day. Guide us to love and follow Your Word with our whole hearts. Amen.
